integrity: The equilibrium, Jacobian entries, modal determinant, and thresholds were reconstructed directly from the printed equations and independently replayed by the included standard-library checker. The source's rounded formula was also evaluated separately.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the printed Section 4 reaction–diffusion equations, the source's modal convention, and the explicit choice d=0.12. It does not determine which diffusion coefficients were used for Figures 5–6, and it does not prove nonlinear patterned-branch existence or stability.
title: Corrected first Turing threshold for the Liu–Zhang forest-disease-fire model
